summary: Arden is a 16-story condominium development at 708-718 Long Bridge Street along Mission Creek, developed by Bosa Development; the Assessor lists 267 unit parcels there with 2016 as the year built, while DBI's new-construction permit (263 dwelling units, 16 stories, filed December 2012) was not recorded complete until February 2019.

milestones.text: DBI new-construction permit 201212246822 filed at 718 Long Bridge St: 'erect 16 stories & 263 dwelling apartment & parking'; issued 2013-10-02

Completed: the Assessor's 2022 roll gives 2016 as year built for the building's unit parcels at 708 and 718 Long Bridge; a sales-agent page says 'Completed in 2016 by Bosa Development'. An architecture database says 'constructed 2014' and Bosa's own page puts its three Mission Bay buildings under 'Active 2005 - 2015', so the year is not firm
DBI records the new-construction permit complete (final sign-off); later than the Assessor's 2016 year built, so it does not date occupancy

costs.what: DBI permit 201212246822's estimated and revised construction cost (both $106,000,000) for the 16-story, 263-unit building at 718 Long Bridge St; a permit valuation, not a vetted development cost

open_questions: No primary opening or first-occupancy date found: the Assessor's 2016 is a year only, and the DBI permit's 2019-02-08 completion is a permit sign-off. The sales-agent page, SF Highrises and the Assessor say 2016; the architecture database says 2014 (and 2013-2014 for construction).
Unit count differs: 263 (DBI, architecture database) versus 267 (SF Highrises; 267 Assessor unit parcels counted).
Architect rests on a sales-agent page and the architecture database (both secondary); no OCII, Planning or architect source read.
Groundbreaking date not found (the DBI permit's first construction document date, 2013-12-06, is not a groundbreaking).
A Business Times article cited by the architecture database ('Bosa prepares next Mission Bay site', March 2013) could not be opened (blocked); not relied on.
No OCII design-review or commission item for Block 12 East was located.
